#!/bin/sh

# Resolve paths relative to this installed entry point.
base=`CDPATH= cd "`dirname "$0"`/.." && pwd` || exit 1
maildir="$base/Maildir"
staging="$maildir/tmp"

umask 077
mkdir -p "$staging" \
    "$maildir/accounts/new" "$maildir/accounts/cur" "$maildir/accounts/tmp" \
    "$maildir/support/new" "$maildir/support/cur" "$maildir/support/tmp" \
    "$maildir/general/new" "$maildir/general/cur" "$maildir/general/tmp" || exit 1

tmp=`mktemp "$staging/deliver.XXXXXX"` || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3 15
cat > "$tmp" || exit 1

department=`awk '
{
    line = $0
    sub(/\r$/, "", line)
    if (line == "")
        exit
    colon = index(line, ":")
    if (colon > 0) {
        name = substr(line, 1, colon - 1)
        value = substr(line, colon + 1)
        gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", name)
        gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", value)
        if (tolower(name) == "x-department") {
            print tolower(value)
            exit
        }
    }
}' "$tmp"`

case "$department" in
    accounts) destination="$maildir/accounts/new" ;;
    support)  destination="$maildir/support/new" ;;
    *)        destination="$maildir/general/new" ;;
esac

stamp=`date +%s`
host=`hostname | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '_'`
suffix=`basename "$tmp" | sed 's/^deliver\.//'`
final="$destination/$stamp.$$.$suffix.$host"

mv "$tmp" "$final" || exit 1
trap - 0 1 2 3 15
exit 0
